title: Chapter 1018
text:
Han Xiao clicked into the post, and as soon as he opened the video, two new hosts appeared on the screen, one male and one female.

"Hello players, I'm Ah Wei," the male host said.

"I'm Cui Hua," the female host said.

"This is the Galaxy Times, dedicated to sharing first-hand game information and protecting your gaming career."

After the usual opening, the two hosts began the routine routine of every episode, trying their best to chat awkwardly.

"The new version has been online for more than half a month. Currently, the players of the various countries are trying their best to adapt. Compared to Version 3.0, Version 4.0 [Flickering World] has a lot of changes. Let me give you a preview in advance. Today's content is very substantial, and we will lead everyone to analyze the gameplay of the new version."

"Speaking of the new version, I thought of something. I have a friend …"

Before he finished, Cui Hua interrupted him. "I know, that friend is yourself. Please continue your performance."

"… That friend of mine, he ran into a ghost recently."

"Where did he run into it?"

Ah Wei was speechless for a while before continuing. "… One day, that friend of mine returned home after working overtime. It was already late at night, and his family was already asleep. He quickly washed up and went to bed hugging his wife. In the middle of the night, in a daze, he heard footsteps outside the door, and he … "

Cui Hua suddenly interrupted with a weird expression. "Wait … what does this have to do with the new version?"

"Ahem, I'm just looking for an excuse to start a conversation. Don't mind these details."

"… Continue." Cui Hua rolled her eyes.

"Only my … friend and his wife lived in the house. He thought that a thief had broken into the house, so he quickly got up and turned on the lights. However, he did not find anyone else, and the door was closed properly, so he went back to sleep. However, when he woke up the next morning to go to work, he found that the door was already open with a gap, but nothing was missing in the house. He thought that he was dreaming last night, so he quickly woke his wife up and asked her if she heard anything last night, but his wife did not hear anything. Don't you think that's scary? He must have run into a ghost. "

"… Eat more green vegetables in the future. It's good for your body and mind," Cui Hua said.

"By the way, what would you do if you really ran into a ghost?"

"I'll kill it with a wave of my flag. Do you think my materialistic halo is fake?"

After this interaction, the two hosts successfully pulled the players' excitement back to normal levels, and they all turned from elated to sullen expressions.

Han Xiao listened to the awkward conversation with an expressionless face. The two hosts finally got to the main topic.

"Back to the topic, Version 4.0 [Flickering World] has been released for half a month," Ah Wei said. "The specialty of this version has already been revealed. That's right, the World Server!"

Cuihua: "Yes, after the baptism of three versions, players from all the countries can finally gather together and play in the same star field. This is a major change in gameplay, and I can foresee that this version will be very lively. It is very likely that there will be a national war, and it will become a fierce battle between players from all the countries."

"Speaking of foresight, I'm reminded of the prediction made by the Galaxy Times in the last episode of Version 3.0. At that time, we speculated that Version 4.0 would fully activate the cross-Star Field function. Now, more than half of our speculations have come true. The only thing we did not guess was the activation of the World Server."

"Due to the appearance of the World Server, the players of the Shattered Star Ring have two natural version advantages. The first is geographical location. As the two Star Fields are adjacent to each other, the players of the Shattered Star Ring can come to the World Server earlier than the players of the other Star Fields. The second is that the players of the Shattered Star Ring have a unique faction advantage. "

"Yes, among the factions that the players are qualified to join, the only faction that came into contact with the Flickering World in the previous version was the Black Star Corps, which included most of the players of the Shattered Star Ring. They followed the army to participate in the first exploration phase of the Flickering World and laid the foundation."

"Not only that, in the new version, the Black Star Corps has become the strongest organization in the Flickering World other than the dynasty. I still remember that the Black Star Corps was the guiding faction of the Shattered Star Ring in Version 2.0. Now that it has developed into such a huge organization, it can provide a huge boost to the players of the Shattered Star Ring in the Flickering World and give them an innate advantage."

"However, I feel that there are two sides to everything. The tallest tree in the forest will be destroyed by the wind. The players of the Shattered Star Ring who have an advantage will very likely become a thorn in the eyes of the players of the other Star Fields."

The two hosts echoed each other and analyzed the situation of the version.

"Regarding the gameplay of the World Server, there are many posts analyzing it. According to our conclusion, the competition in Version 4.0 will most likely be dominated by guilds. Normal players will have more freedom and more room to maneuver, but the efficiency of obtaining resources will not be comparable to guilds. "

"And our basis is the system recently announced by the Black Star Corps …" Ah Wei suddenly paused, hesitated, and said, "Speaking of which, how many times have we predicted the version with the Black Star Corps as the wind vane?"

As soon as this was said, the players who were watching the show seriously instantly went berserk, and comments flooded the screen.

"It's true. Everything originated from the Black Star Corps. Without the army, the Galaxy Times wouldn't even know how to make a show."

"Ah Wei: It's very easy to make a prediction. Just summarize the Black Star Corps' movements."

"Trash show, all thanks to the army (laughing emoji)."

"Official bootlickers, can't be washed away."

"Black Star: That's right, I'm the most handsome guy in the Shattered Star Ring."

"… To the person above, is there something wrong with the window to the soul?"

"Ocean Blue Rising Battle Robes, Pork Bun on the left, Times on the right, Black Star Shining, Waves of the Galaxy ~"

"Here? You're the literary tycoon? "

"Write a book if you know how to talk."

The idiotic netizens started to show off again, and Han Xiao was very happy.

This wave of bootlickers was very comfortable. It was not in vain that I had been providing benefits and guiding the version.

Cui Hua coughed and said, "Back to business, the Black Star Corps' movements are an important reference. The new system that they announced a while ago, the core mechanism is to turn guilds into official organizations in the universe, giving the players a chance to be independent."

"Independence has always been relatively unpopular in the previous versions, mainly because the conditions were not right. However, in Version 4.0, the level cap has increased, and the influence of independence has increased. This gameplay may become more important."

"The Black Star Corps has guided this gameplay. According to their past deeds, this may become the mainstream gameplay in Version 4.0, encouraging more people to form guilds."

"However! All players, please pay attention! Normal independence requires leaving the original faction. So far, only the Black Star Corps has a semi-independent system. In other words, only army players can be independent while retaining the affiliation of the Black Star Corps! This is another unique advantage! "

"Currently, it is not clear if this is one of the characteristics of the Black Star Corps. If the factions of the players in the other Star Fields do not have this system, I feel that many foreign players will switch to the Black Star Corps. Therefore, the question now is, if they become players of the same faction, will there still be a national war?"

The analysis is quite accurate, Han Xiao thought to himself.

This was a good thing for him. It would help promote the superiority of his system and make the players more aware of the convenience of the army, increasing the attractiveness of the faction.

The program then analyzed the possibility of the players in the world server in detail, as well as the movements of the players in the various Star Fields. Han Xiao watched the whole process, mainly focusing on the movements of the players in the other Star Fields.

Unlike the Shattered Star Ring, the players in the other Star Fields did not have a unified faction. They were all scattered, and they were currently traveling across Star Fields with their factions. There were also quite a number of lone wolf players who had left the faction. Most of them were from America and Europe. After all, different places nurtured different people. Breathing in the sweet air, the genes of freedom were imperceptibly engraved in their bones.

The factions that the players belonged to were worth paying attention to, and most of them were small organizations.

Small organizations were nothing to worry about. There were too many powerful organizations in the Flickering World, and the channels to join them would be opened up on a large scale in Version 4.0. The players would be like being surrounded by countless disheveled vixens. How could they resist this temptation? They would immediately abandon the old and abandon the new.

Furthermore, many people did not like to break up peacefully. They would directly cheat and become scumbags who betrayed their old faction in exchange for Contribution Points.

Han Xiao remembered many cases. There were even players who purposely used the name of a small organization to provoke a big crocodile, leading to a wave of betrayal and attracting a strong enemy for the small organization. This caused the destruction of the old faction, and they would join the new enemy faction for a promotion and a raise. This was the epitome of shamelessness.

To many players, integrity was nothing. Small organizations were not attractive and weak, so the players would not miss them. However, for a large faction like his, which had benefits and strength, normal players would cherish it and would not do such a thing.

Other than small organizations, there were also foreign players who worked for powerful organizations, such as the Limitless Financial Group, the Galactic Black Market, the Extinguish Army, and some Star Cluster or even Supercluster civilizations. Depending on the region, there were more or less' Immortals' from different countries.

"Especially that bastard Sorokin. He recruited many players and even tested the army players in the past. He's probably trying to poach my people in the Flickering World." Han Xiao secretly curled his lips.

The Limitless Financial Group mainly recruited people in the Sea of Star Spirits, mainly Japanese and Korean players. The Extinguish Army was an important faction for the Americans. These two organizations had the most players other than the Black Star Corps.

At the mention of the Extinguish Army, Han Xiao could not help but think of Beyoni. Beyoni was the leader of the Flame Demon Race, and the Extinguish Army was mainly made up of the Frost Demon Race. The two could be considered enemies. Beyoni controlled the Land of the Fire Core, while the Extinguish Army controlled the Land of the Frost Core. Even the treasures of their respective races were very similar.

Just as he was thinking, Han Xiao suddenly had a thought. He opened his attribute interface and saw that his experience bar was increasing rapidly.

"Hehe, our promotion is working."

…

Dynasty, Temple of God, Long Sky, and the other first-tier professional clubs had all registered as official organizations in the Black Star Corps. The name of the organization was not changed and directly followed the name of the guild.

After receiving Han Xiao's instructions, Philip turned on the lights and quickly approved the procedures for the guilds to become official members one after another. The organizational structure of the army players changed drastically, and they officially became recognized affiliated guilds. Their records were set up in the army.

After completing the registration, these large guilds immediately allowed a portion of their members to participate in the main storyline exploration mission and obtain many benefits promised by Han Xiao. To these large guilds, they could also use these benefits to attract many players who did not have guilds to join them. It was mutually beneficial.

After twenty years of continuous hard work by the logistics department, the equipment of the army was all new models, and the equipment of the players were all outdated models from twenty years ago and needed to be updated. Coupled with the stimulation of the seventy percent discount, the desire to spend was unprecedentedly high, and there was a shopping frenzy in the military supply department.

A large amount of Enas entered his account, but to Han Technician, the money that the players brought was only a small profit. What was more important was the experience. He had added the experience fee to more faction products and introduced a new system. The players could choose two payment methods, either with money or experience. If they did not have money in their pockets, they could directly use experience to buy.

In the eyes of the other army members, this was a little strange. It was like giving away equipment for free. However, now that Han Xiao was fully fledged, he did not need to be as careful as before when it came to dealing with the players. As long as he said that the Immortals had special privileges, it could be explained away.

The result was that the efficiency of harvesting experience increased exponentially. Experience was a special currency that belonged to the players. Currently, only the Black Star Corps had the service of donating experience for money. The other factions could not learn it even if they wanted to.

Millions of army players arrived at the Black Star Palace in a few days, but the foreign players from the other Star Fields were still rushing. According to the itinerary of the players, the second to arrive in the world server should be the Southeast Asian players from Blackhole Edge, mainly Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Singapore. However, that would take many days, and the Chinese players had plenty of time to expand their advantage.

Under the mobilization of the Black Star Corps, the players were roughly divided into two groups. One group followed the fleet led by Hella and set off for the fourth exploration phase, preparing to participate in the competition between the foreign organizations.

The remaining players were mostly guild members. Using the benefits that Han Xiao promised, they chose to build their guild strongholds in the army's territory and used their Team Merit Points to purchase resource points and various business operations rights, beginning to build a stronger foundation for their respective guilds.

Under the control of Han Xiao, all the army players were mobilized, developing step by step according to the path that he had pointed out, using the mainstream playstyle that had been proven in his previous life to expand their lead in the world server step by step.

At the same time, the fleet led by Hella followed the other foreign organizations and arrived at the fourth exploration phase.

The current situation could be summed up in one word:

— — Demon Dance!

…
